```python
def solve(case):
    nodes = case['nodes']
    required_symbols = set(case['required_symbols'])
    # build maps
    node_map = {n['id']: n for n in nodes}
    children = {}
    for n in nodes:
        pid = n['parent']
        if pid is not None:
            children.setdefault(pid, []).append(n['id'])
    # all ids initially retained
    retained = set(n['id'] for n in nodes)
    removed_order = []
    # Sort nodes by depth descending, then id ascending
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n['depth'], n['id']))
    for n in sorted_nodes:
        nid = n['id']
        if nid not in retained:
            continue
        # never remove root
        if n['depth'] == 0:
            continue
        if not n['removable']:
            continue
        if n['symbol'] in required_symbols:
            continue
        # check if any children are still retained
        has_retained_child = False
        for child_id in children.get(nid, []):
            if child_id in retained:
                has_retained_child = True
                break
        if has_retained_child:
            continue
        # remove
        retained.remove(nid)
        removed_order.append(nid)
    retained_sorted = sorted(retained)
    return {
        'removed_node_ids': removed_order,
        'retained_node_ids': retained_sorted
    }
```
